data.description:
## Class

`src/rebar/reducer/marker.py` guards the `fcntl` **import** (lines 8-11, `except ImportError: fcntl = None`)
but not its **use**: `write_marker` calls `fcntl.flock(lock_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)` and
`fcntl.flock(lock_fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)` unguarded.

When `fcntl is None` (Windows), `None.flock` raises `AttributeError`. The enclosing
`except OSError:` does **not** catch `AttributeError`, so it propagates out of a function whose
documented contract is "on any OSError: logs a warning and returns without raising" — the archive
marker write becomes a hard failure instead of a logged degradation.

Found while plan-reviewing S1 (`friendless-alabaster-cub`): S1's plan cited this module as a
correctly-guarded sibling, and the reviewer falsified that citation. `_snapshot/git_fetch.py:79` and
`_snapshot/janitor.py:430` DO gate their use sites with `if fcntl is not None:`; this one does not.

**Explicitly out of S1's scope** — S1's file impact is `_store/lock.py` + `_store/lock_owner.py`
(the store write lock). This is the per-ticket archive-marker lock, a different mechanism on a
different path, and folding it into S1 would widen the blast radius of a core-concurrency change for
no benefit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `write_marker` never dereferences `fcntl` when it is `None`. Checked by a unit test that
      monkeypatches `marker.fcntl = None` and asserts the marker is still written and no exception
      escapes (the established simulation seam — see `tests/unit/store/test_git_locking_no_fcntl.py`).
- [ ] The degraded (no-`fcntl`) path still creates `<ticket_dir>/.archived`. Checked by the same test
      asserting the marker file exists.
- [ ] POSIX behaviour is unchanged: `pytest tests/unit -k marker -q` stays green.

## Testing

1. RED first: the monkeypatched-`fcntl=None` test must raise `AttributeError` before the fix.
2. GREEN after: the guard makes the lock a no-op on a platform without `fcntl`, matching the
   already-shipped shape of `_snapshot/git_fetch.py` and `_snapshot/janitor.py`.
data.title: reducer/marker.py dereferences fcntl when it is None (import guarded, use site not)
